subject: Startups
title: Gross Margin
description: Learn Gross Margin in one minute.

hook.text: Revenue means nothing if it costs $0.90 to earn $1.00. Gross margin reveals how much you actually keep.

buildup.text: Gross margin is revenue minus cost of goods sold, divided by revenue. SaaS companies target 70–80%.

discovery.text: High margins mean scaling is profitable. Each new customer adds real money, not just more costs.

twist.text: Some startups hide costs to inflate margins. Counting engineering as R&D instead of COGS is a common trick.

climax.text: Investors love high gross margins because they fund growth, R&D, and sales. Low margins leave no room to invest.

punchline.text: Revenue is vanity. Gross margin is sanity.

quiz.question: Why do investors care about gross margin?
options: It shows how much revenue is available to fund growth
